        # We need a, g(a), b, a+b, a-b, a-g(a)-b to be known to find a+g(a)+b

                    val = g[a+b] + g[a-b] - g[a-ga-b]
                    if (a + ga + b) not in g:

                        changed = True
                
                # Case 2: find g(a - ga - b)
                # Need g(a+ga+b), g(a+b), g(a-b)
                if (a + ga + b) in g and (a + b) in g and (a - b) in g:
                    val = g[a+b] + g[a-b] - g[a+ga+b]
                    if (a - ga - b) not in g:
                        g[a - ga - b] = val
                        changed = True
                
                # Case 3: find g(a+b)
                # Need g(a+ga+b), g(a-ga-b), g(a-b)
                if (a + ga + b) in g and (a - ga - b) in g and (a - b) in g:
                    val = g[a + ga + b] + g[a - ga - b] - g[a - b]
                    if (a + b) not in g:
                        g[a+b] = val
                        changed = True
                
                # Case 4: find g(a-b)
                # Need g(a+ga+b), g(a-ga-b), g(a+b)
                if (a + ga + b) in g and (a - ga - b) in g and (a + b) in g:
                    val = g[a + ga + b] + g[a - ga - b] - g[a+b]
                    if (a - b) not in g:

                        changed = True
        if not changed:
            break
    return g
